recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. The seed issue's current-spec metadata and naming concerns are now satisfied without expanding into unrelated OID cleanup, catalog ownership transfer, or future catalog concept requests.
issue_request: FHIR-37439 asked to correct the CatalogType CodeSystem and ValueSet, which were missing required status metadata, missing descriptions, and using non-standard CamelCase naming; Jira status is Applied with Persuasive resolution for R6.
initial_application: Commit 005457a65c added kebab-case catalog-type CodeSystem and ValueSet source files and updated the Catalog profile binding; commit e3c3d0fe20 added active status metadata. Those applications left the CodeSystem description as only 'CatalogType' and the ValueSet description as 'Description Needed Here'.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/composition terminology XML is in build scope. Confluence minutes confirm OO reassigned the tracker to SD and SD expected Khalid to apply the small technical correction. FHIR-53300 later noted value set duplicate-definition warnings involving valueset-catalog-type's placeholder description, but that broader issue was resolved no-change and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/composition/codesystem-catalog-type.xml to describe the FHIR-defined catalog types, and source/composition/valueset-catalog-type.xml to describe the included FHIR-defined catalog type codes. Left the already-applied ids, URLs, status values, standards status extensions, and Catalog profile binding unchanged.
source_changes: source/composition/codesystem-catalog-type.xml: replaced the nominal CatalogType description with a meaningful CodeSystem description.
source/composition/valueset-catalog-type.xml: replaced the placeholder Description Needed Here text with a meaningful ValueSet description.
